statement: Linux v7.3-rc1 hid-steam for direct USB 28de:1302 attempts serial GET via feature1 command 0xae with string attribute id 0x01 then GET attributes command 0x83; serial failure/empty uses placeholder and attribute failure logs but both are nonfatal for registration, which proceeds to lizard SET, evdev/sensor creation. Attribute tag ATTRIB_CONNECTION_INTERVAL_IN_US (0x0b) adjusts host sensor interval, not an IMU calibration. Direct wired probe does not send wireless dongle feature2 GET; conditional on WIRELESS quirk. Feature parsing/replies are consumer expectations, physical actual values: No evidence. K 618-717,1372-1420,1798-1804.
